title: From 500 Backtested Strategies to One Profitable GBPUSD Edge Using fine tuned AI
author: Vegetable_Ferret2328
selftext:
Hi everyone, I am Idris Paul.  
I am a Full-Stack Developer with about 7 years of experience, and I have been involved in forex and stock trading for the past 8 years, since 2018.  
Trading has always been something I am passionate about, but my biggest challenge was not knowledge or risk management. It was finding a strategy that actually holds a long-term edge and staying consistent with it.  
Before AI, building and properly backtesting strategies took a lot of time, which made progress slow. Because of that, I shifted my focus more toward software engineering for a while.  
With the rise of AI, things started to change. It opened doors into machine learning, data science, and AI engineering, so I decided to continue my Master’s in Computer Science with a focus on AI and Data Science. My goal was to apply AI directly to trading and build models that can identify real and lasting market edges.  
One thing I have learned is that there is a big difference between being a trading mentor or a theoretical trader and actually being consistently profitable. I had experience mentoring, but consistency in live markets was still a major issue because strategies would fail over time.  
So I approached it differently using AI.  
I combined concepts like Bayesian probability, Monte Carlo simulations, empirical probability, Smart Money Concepts, and supply and demand. I backtested over 500 strategies across different timeframes and kept filtering them down.  
Out of 68 trading pairs via broker API, only one held up consistently, which is GBPUSD.  
Since focusing on that, I have been able to find a working edge and stay profitable.  
I also built a trading bot around this system. It trades only GBPUSD and includes proper risk management such as stop-loss, take-profit, entries, and slippage control. Execution is handled by an MT4 Expert Advisor, while the logic and signals come from a Python dashboard connected through an API.  
Right now, I have a small track record with OANDA US, and I am planning to integrate MyFxBook starting July 26, 2026, for more transparency.  
My goal is to scale this system and eventually manage larger capital. I am open to anyone interested in testing the bot signals or discussing potential collaboration.  
Happy to answer any questions.

comments.author: hotdogs4babies
comments.body:
Okay in case anybody else was wondering, ( I'm very interested in this tool specifically because I have nothing assisting me with foreign exchange yet)
I didn't really want to go backward to mt4 from my mt5 profile I have a few different accounts going through there. So I took a look and there are several things you can do there is a basic code rewriter that for basic code you can use mt4 and it'll rewrite mt5 code or mql5 code. Another thing is the copytrader which is a really probably the best way to go is set up a dummy mt4 account with foreign exchange quotes and have that copy trade to your mt5 since you can program your own risk parameters into the AI tool. Hopefully that helps somebody out
